solves.reasoning: embodied = incorporated (구현된/통합된). 'A clock is really a process embodied in a machine' = the process is given physical form within the machine. Separated (분리된), abandoned (버려진), extracted (추출된) all contradict the meaning. Incorporated = 포함된/구현된 = direct synonym.

'recognize objects under changing _____(illuminate)' — after 'changing' (adjective modifying noun), a noun is needed. 'Illumination' (명사) → plural 'illuminations' to parallel 'situations' and 'contexts'. The sentence lists 'illuminations, situations, and contexts' as three parallel nouns.
empty (빈/비어 있는) 반의어 = occupied (채워진/사람이 있는). Vacant/hollow/barren are all synonyms or close synonyms of empty. Occupied = filled/in use = direct antonym of empty.

③ 'favorable' is wrong: 'you may have a favorable self-evaluation, feeling that your academic performance is not up to par' — favorable (좋은/유리한) directly contradicts 'not up to par' (기준에 못 미치는). The passage says 'negative self-evaluation'. Favorable creates a contradiction within the same sentence.

(A) hypothesis — academia = start with hypothesis, then do experiments; conclusion would put the ending first. (B) patience — 'don't have the patience to wait for your big reveal'; courage doesn't fit 'wait for'. (C) majority — 'the vast majority know what you've achieved'; minority contradicts 'vast' and the positive framing.

'experienced through the actions/experiences of another rather than directly' = vicarious (대리적인). The passage uses 'vicarious functioning' = the brain using alternative pathways. Simultaneous/spontaneous/autonomous don't match this definition of experiencing through another.

(A) 'the conveniently straight line of the twenty-second parallel of latitude' — here 'line' = a geographic boundary line (경계선). (B) 'Please wait in line until your number is called' — here 'line' = a queue (대기 줄). So (A) = (경계) 선 = choice 1.

Blank: 'here too there is ____' — the passage immediately follows with 'the repeated burning of molecules of wax — so this too is an iterative process'. Iteration = repetition of a process. The sentence sets up iteration as the explanation. Stagnation/variation/progression all contradict the repetitive theme.

Blank: 'comparison effects and associative effects on __________' — reference groups affect how people judge themselves = self-appraisals (자기평가). The passage uses 'self-evaluation' throughout, making 'self-appraisals' the exact contextual fit. Group membership/academic records/community projects are all too specific.

convince = persuade (설득하다). 'You can more likely convince more readers to stay' = persuade them to stay. Compel (강요), deceive (속이다), distract (주의를 분산) are all wrong or have negative connotations. Persuade = convince = to influence through reasoning.
proud (자랑스러운) 반의어 = ashamed (부끄러운). Confident/satisfied/hopeful are all positive feelings similar to proud. Ashamed = feeling shame/embarrassment = direct antonym of proud.
'the __________ (norm) effect' — the blank precedes 'effect' (noun) so an adjective is needed. Norm (명사) → normative (형용사). 'The normative effect of a reference group' is exact passage phrasing.

normative = prescriptive (규범적인/규정하는). Normative = relating to norms/standards that guide behavior = prescriptive (규칙/표준을 정하는). Destructive/optional/accidental are all wrong. Normative and prescriptive both refer to setting behavioral standards.

④ 'struggle' is wrong: 'if most of your classmates struggle in academic achievement' — passage says 'shine'. The comparison effect requires classmates who excel, creating a basis for negative self-comparison. If they struggle, there would be no 'brilliant group' association. Shine (빛나다) vs. struggle (어려움을 겪다) are antonyms.

'internal features such as eyes are hardly _____. (visible → 어법에 맞게)' — 'visible' is already an adjective. After 'are hardly' (linking verb + adverb), an adjective is needed: 'visible'. No transformation required; the word stays as 'visible'.

'the large, _____ coastal area called the Hala'ib Triangle' — blank modifies 'coastal area'. Inhabit (동사) → inhabitable (형용사: able to be inhabited/lived in). The passage describes Hala'ib as livable/inhabitable in contrast to the desert patch of Bir Tawil.

Blank: 'recognize the face of a celebrity in __________ made with just a few pencil strokes' — the passage describes simplified drawings that capture essential features. Caricatures = exaggerated/simplified drawings using few strokes. Portraits/sculptures/photographs all require more detail than 'a few pencil strokes'.

Blank: 'basking in __________ glory' — 'basking in reflected glory' is the exact idiom from the reference group passage. Pride comes from association with a successful group = the glory is reflected onto you from the group. Reflected = bounced back/transmitted = choice 1.
masked (가려진/숨겨진) 반의어 = evident (명확한/분명한). Hidden/concealed/obscured are all synonyms of masked. Evident = clearly visible/obvious = direct antonym of masked.

(A) reveal — online readers don't wait for 'your big reveal at the end'; secret would mean you're hiding it. (B) up front — you need to tell readers 'up front' (미리/먼저) rather than making them wait; 'in detail' contradicts the concise opening required. (C) grab — 'grab their attention early' = hook readers quickly; release is the opposite.
